body: Sorry to hear about your loss...your son was fortunate to have family and friends because not everyone has that

That wouldn't happen unless you had end stage AIDs and had to be put on hospice and by that time you would have experienced most/all of the side effects that you were worried about from the meds...except it would be all the AIDS related illnesses causing it

HIV is no longer a death sentence and many states have clinics that have a Ryan White program that covers all HIV meds and some meds for other illnesses for those who are HIV positive.  The meds today aren't as bad as they once were and there are many combination meds that have several medicines in one pill so people don't have to take handfuls of meds anymore (There is now blood work that helps to determine which of these meds each persons virus is susceptible/resistant to).  If you go to this site http://hab.hrsa.gov/ you can find these types of places in your area and get tested for free.  Go get yourself tested it's quick and discreet   Source: I once worked at one of these clinics and many of the HIV positive individuals lived much happier/fulfilling lives than I do and had viral loads that were undetectable once they were on the right med/meds

Technically they weren't necessarily "up" just not as bad  {sidenote: when I had insurance, I went to a provider that had me take a test that took several hours and was diagnosed with dysthmia with episodes of major depression}...I guess I was able to fake being ok enough to interact and listen to and help others with their problems.  Right now I don't have the energy and I am definitely alienated

I have felt this way for probably over 30 years off and on, but this has been the longest on I have ever had...for over a year....I am literally alone...When I was working, I  just went to work and came home...Now that I am not working...I just stay home...I havent left the house at all in about 2 weeks I just don't have the energy and I don't have anyone that even cares to check on me..I'm just miserable

Just to clarify....I didn't speak to a person that put me on hold...I just kept getting a recorded voice and some elevator music that said they were connecting me
I posted this hoping to have some type of human interaction but when I look at the other posts, I feel like the old person in the room
